schema:
CREATE TABLE accounts (account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tier TEXT);
CREATE TABLE monthly_usage (account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, period_code TEXT NOT NULL, units REAL, PRIMARY KEY (period_code, account_id), FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (account_id));
correct_query: SELECT SUBSTRING(T2.period_code, 5, 2) FROM accounts AS T1 INNER JOIN monthly_usage AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE SUBSTRING(T2.period_code, 1, 4) = '2022' AND T1.tier = 'PRO' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2.period_code, 5, 2) ORDER BY SUM(T2.units) DESC, SUBSTRING(T2.period_code, 5, 2) NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
